'''HK-130''' was a [[Sentry droid/Legends|sentry droid]] of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorran]] manufacture. It consisted of a tiny metal ball propelled by [[Repulsorlift/Legends|microrepulsors]] and covered with silver studs that emitted powerful [[Stun/Legends|stun]] beams. Scanning each individual it encountered in order to determine its threat level, it was considered a troublemaker.
